name: astroix-qualification-unsupported-node-sass
description: The L2 negative qualification fixture (#259): a managed-project dependency manifest declaring node-sass 9 — MANIFEST-ONLY INPUT. Nothing in this directory is ever installed, built, or executed; the prelaunch screening (reject.mjs, driven by scripts/candidate) reads these manifest bytes and rejects the dependency deterministically before any launch. The declaration is real on purpose: the screener must catch an actual dependencies entry, never a synthetic side channel.
